extensionDescription.message: Connect a selected Chrome tab to your local Hoxi session

hint.message: Paste a Hoxi connection code for the first pairing, or click Connect directly once paired. New tabs opened from this tab are followed automatically

code.message: Hoxi connection code (optional after first pairing)

quickConnect.message: Quick connect this tab (no code needed)

disconnected.message: Disconnected; your Chrome tab remains open
